name: Summer Kickoff Tournament
description: A friendly tournament to start the season featuring local youth teams from southern Buenos Aires.

name: Parents Information Night
description: An informative session for parents to learn about training expectations, safety, and upcoming competitions.

name: Mid-Season Skills Challenge
description: Players compete in dribbling, passing, and shooting events to test improvement and earn academy badges.

name: Coaches Workshop Day
description: A full-day event where the coaching staff participates in workshops to update training methods and techniques.

name: End of Season Exhibition
description: All academy groups present what they learned throughout the season in an organized showcase for families.
